semiconductor_relevance: High — New YF Precision Corporation specializes in semiconductor process-related equipment and technologies, making it a key player in the industry.
summary: New YF Precision Corporation is a leading provider of thin film and surface treatment technologies, offering customized equipment and technical services for semiconductor processes. The company focuses on improving process yields and technological advancements in wafer fabrication, optoelectronic modules, and advanced packaging.
capabilities: Alternating Layer (ALD) technology for TEM sample preparation
